segments.he: גְּמָ׳ מַאֲכִילָתוֹ שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְעוּשָּׂר, הֵיכִי דָמֵי? אִי דְּיָדַע — נִפְרוֹשׁ. אִי דְּלָא יָדַע — מְנָא יָדַע? לָא צְרִיכָא, דְּאָמְרָה לֵיהּ ״פְּלוֹנִי כֹּהֵן תִּיקֵּן לִי אֶת הַכְּרִי״, וְאָזֵיל שַׁיְילֵיהּ, וְאִשְׁתְּכַח שִׁיקְרָא.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The mishna stated: «She feeds him» food «that has not been tithed.» The Gemara attempts to clarify: «What are the circumstances» of the case under discussion? «If he knows» that the food is untithed, «he should abstain» and not eat it. And «if he does not know» that the food is untithed, then «how does he know» that she in fact fed him such food, so that he can divorce her? The Gemara responds: «No,» it is «necessary when she tells him: So-and-so» the «priest rectified the pile» of grain «for me» by tithing it, «and he» then «went and asked» the priest whether he did so, «and it was found» to be «a lie.» It is therefore clear that she did not tithe the food before she served it to him.
